values.note: Closure order: 'Grasshopper Campground ... is closed in its entirety' for 'campground updates, culvert installations, and general site enhancements from 0600 on July 27, 2026 through 1800 on November 1, 2026', or until rescinded.

values.note: Paid on site; fees still apply when the water is off.

values.note: 22 ft is the maximum TRAILER length; 'large RVs are not recommended.'

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/grasshopper-campground ('Its 12 sites sit above Grasshopper Creek', 'Maximum trailer length is 22 feet; large RVs are not recommended.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Potable water in warmer months only. Food storage order March 1 - December 1. Horses not allowed.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/grasshopper-campground ('Potable water is available in warmer months; vault toilets are accessible', 'Horses are not allowed', 'A food storage order is in effect March 1 to December 1'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'The campground typically closes in early December'; opening and closing dates vary with snowfall. No opening date published.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/grasshopper-campground ('The campground typically closes in early December', 'Opening and closing dates vary with snowfall'), read 2026-10-22

note: Helena-Lewis & Clark NF campground ~11 mi from White Sulphur Springs (east on US 12, then 4 mi south on FR 211), the only developed campground in the Castle Mountains, on a hillside above Grasshopper Creek (distinct from the Beaverhead-Deerlodge Grasshopper CG near Elkhorn Hot Springs). Teardrop loop road is tight. Popular with late-season hunters (hanging game not allowed). --Claude
summary: FS page (updated July 29, 2026) confirms $10, FCFS, 16-day limit, 12 sites, 22-ft max trailer; added vault toilets and seasonal potable water, season 'typically closes in early December'. Closure order closes the whole campground July 27 - Nov 1, 2026 for culvert/site work: recorded status temporarily_closed. Hookups (derived none) left. Note trimmed of restated values.
